valence.lyrics.mode.desc.sky: Words appear in 3D in the sky. Blocks in front hide them.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.world: The lyrics float right in front of you, wherever you look (best for PvP).
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.auto: In the world while you fight, otherwise in the sky.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.screen: Flat on the screen with a light 3D tilt.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.bar: No 3D text, only the bar at the top.
valence.perf.maxfps.desc: Turns off everything that costs FPS. Switch it off and all your settings come back.
valence.perf.maxfps.on: On: sky details, particles, shooting stars, star signs, lightning and lyric glow are off, sky quality is Max FPS.
valence.perf.maxfps.off: Off: your own effect settings are used.

valence.lyrics.follow.desc: On: the lyrics move with you when you turn. Off: they stay where they appeared.
valence.sky.quality.desc: Auto lowers the sky detail by itself when your FPS drop and raises it again when they are high.
valence.lyrics.where.info.0: Sky: the lyrics are written big into the sky above you.
valence.lyrics.where.info.1: Floating: the lyrics float right in front of you, wherever you look (best for PvP).
valence.lyrics.where.info.2: Screen: the lyrics sit fixed on your screen, like subtitles.

valence.info.changelog.100:
v1.0.0
• Styles from your own PvP packs (also 1.8 packs), mixed per item, everything turns in 3D
• Totem size: normal, small or tiny
• 21 GPU-shader skies, better Saturn, galaxy, blood moon, comet and eclipse
• Sky preview with quick settings
• Spotify lyrics: play/pause/skip, better word sync, new song title card
• FPS & ping in the HUD, Lithium built in, own entity culling
valence.info.credits: Lyrics: LRCLIB (lrclib.net). Fonts: Poppins, DM Serif Display, Abril Fatface, Pacifico, Kaushan Script, Bangers, Lilita One (SIL OFL 1.1) and Luckiest Guy (Apache 2.0). Made with love for the Valence community.
valence.sky.animations.desc: Turns all movement in the sky on or off.
valence.sky.lightning.desc: Flashes and lightning bolts in storm skies.
valence.sky.clouds.desc: The blocky Minecraft clouds rarely fit custom skies.
valence.sky.preview.title: Sky preview
valence.sky.preview.nosky: This dimension has no sky – try it in the Overworld.
valence.lyrics.status.hint: Play a song in the Spotify app
valence.settings.sounds.desc: Quiet sounds when hovering and clicking.
valence.styles.empty.title: Add your own packs
valence.styles.empty.text: Put PvP texture packs (.zip) into your resourcepacks folder – old 1.8 packs work too – and press "Rescan". They show up here next to the Valence styles.

Lithium and ImmediatelyFast are built into Valence and work on every PC. Sodium may not be bundled – install it for the biggest FPS boost.
valence.styles.desc.builtin: A Valence style: made for this item, still clearly recognizable.
valence.lyrics.wordsync.desc: Uses lyrics where every single word has its own time (if the song has them), so each word appears exactly when it is sung.
valence.settings.performance.install.inf: One click downloads Sodium (official, from Modrinth) into your mods folder. Often a lot more FPS. Active after restarting Minecraft.

valence.info.changelog.110:
v1.1.0
• All skies reworked: no more line at the horizon (fog and sky now match exactly), light shafts reach all the way down, cleaner aurora and galaxy
• Sky resolution setting (Auto / Sharp / Balanced / Max FPS) and the sky is only repainted when needed: much more FPS
• New sky preview: "Preview" on every picture, camera flies up to the sky, look around with the mouse, settings on the right
• Lyrics: word-perfect sync (every word appears when it is sung), smoother timing, finer offset
• 5 menu sounds: Glass, Creamy Keys, Clicky Keys, Bubble, Minecraft
• One click Sodium install for more FPS
• Menu opens and closes without pictures jumping
valence.page.cosmetics.subtitle: Hats, crosshair, trail and kill animations.
valence.page.cosmetics.desc: 27 hats, crosshairs, trails and kill effects.
valence.page.hud.subtitle: Bar at the top, glass hotbar, logo and colors.
valence.page.hud.desc: Top bar, glass hotbar and accent color.
valence.info.credits.cord: Sky, lyrics, HUD and cosmetics engine based on Lyrics Cord by polishtraps85 (MIT license).
valence.info.changelog.120:
v1.2.0
• New sky engine: 20 skies with weather (snow, rain, thunder, petals, embers, fireflies) that run on every graphics card, incl. a custom sky editor
• Lyrics in 3D in the sky or floating around you, 22 fonts, 3 animations, glow, beat pulse, song intro, translation
• Spotify: automatic on Windows (no login) or via the Spotify Web API, album cover, word-perfect sync
• New top bar with clock, ping, FPS and karaoke line, glass hotbar, custom crosshairs
• Cosmetics: 27 hats, trails, aura, beat border and kill animations
• Automatic FPS control, Chill / PvP profile, FPS boost
valence.page.performance.subtitle: Always smooth – Valence tunes itself.
valence.page.performance.desc: FPS, graphics, Chill / PvP and effects.
valence.perf.graphics.desc: How detailed the sky and lyrics are drawn
valence.perf.profile.desc: PvP: effects off, max FPS and clean floating lyrics
valence.perf.glow.desc: Costs the most when many words are shown
valence.settings.blur.desc: Blurs the game behind the menu
valence.info.changelog.130:
v1.3.0
• The menu looks the same size and sharp at every GUI scale (1, 2, 3, 4, Auto)
• Music stage next to the menu: big cover, spinning record, lyric line, waveform with previous / play / next / save
• New "Performance" page: live FPS, graphics Performance / Balanced / Pretty, Chill / PvP, all effects on / off
• PvP profile with its own clean lyric look (floating, Caveat, cream, no glow)
• New floating lyrics: every word appears exactly when it is sung
• New lyric bar at the top: smooth karaoke fill, gliding lines, song progress
• More exact song position from Spotify, more even word timing
• New "Sunset" sky instead of Blood moon, reworked Watercolor
• New default sound "Soft", plus Creamy Keys and Glass, volume 20 % by default
• Rounded corners on every picture (banner, skies, covers)
• Smoother animations when opening, closing and switching
• Galaxy style removed
valence.settings.skymode.info: Active now: %s. "Automatic" uses the picture mode on AMD cards and wherever the sky shader does not run – it looks the same, it just moves more slowly.
valence.lyrics.where.desc: In the sky, floating around you or fixed on screen
valence.lyrics.reveal.desc: Word by word, the whole line, or only the word that is sung
valence.info.changelog.192:
v1.9.2
• Lyrics disappear when the song is paused and come back when it goes on
• Lyric offset starts at 0 (no delay)
• Top bar starts with FPS and ping only, the Valence logo in the corner starts off
valence.info.changelog.191:
v1.9.1
• Floating lyrics are smaller (about as big as in the sky), flat and clean: no outline, no 3D look
• Color: Gradient shows two colors, One color only one
• Glow is off until you turn it on (styles no longer switch it on)
valence.info.changelog.190:
v1.9.0
• The lyrics of Valence 1.0 are back: soft arc in the sky, floating in front of you or on screen, 9 one-click styles, 10 fonts, two colors, glow, outline and tilt
• Sky lyrics stay up in the sky (also when you look down) and are always behind blocks
• Word by word, whole line or one word at a time, every word appears where you look
• Now playing is shown the same way as your lyrics (sky, floating or screen)
valence.info.changelog.181:
v1.8.1
• Sky lyrics sit in front of hills and far terrain, only blocks close in front can cover them
• Now playing intro appears exactly like the floating words when you use that mode, and makes room for the first lyric line
• License screen: wrong key shakes with a sound, right key turns green with a bing, texts stay inside the panel
• Option texts never run under the switches
valence.info.changelog.180:
v1.8.0
• License key: Valence is activated once with your key, then it stays active on your PC
• Lyrics are now behind blocks and in front of water, never on the ground when you look down
• Cleaner lyrics: one tidy line in front of you or in the sky, no overlapping lines
• New song intro shows up where your lyrics are (in front of you or in the sky)
• Max FPS mode: one switch, everything comes back when you switch it off
• ImmediatelyFast built in for faster HUD and text rendering
valence.info.changelog.170:
v1.7.0
• New Aurora: brighter curtains in green, teal and pink; nicer suns on Sunset and Desert
• Sky quality setting (Auto / High / Balanced / Max FPS): Auto lowers the sky detail by itself when your FPS drop
• Lyrics: the best fonts as big previews, gradient colors (two-color palettes), "Follow view" setting, sky lyrics are bigger
• Better automatic lyric sync (network delay is taken into account, less jitter)
• Styles: Fire removed (fire height is now under Performance), Hotbar moved to the bottom
• Totem pop animation: Off / Small / Normal
valence.info.changelog.160:
v1.6.0
• Skies: back to the sky engine of Valence 1.0 (no shaders, runs on every PC, laptop and graphics card) with 25 skies
• New: Golden Sunset, Pink Sunset, Blue Sun, White Sun; star signs on starry skies; Blood moon and second planet removed
• Smooth fade when switching skies
• Low fire works again (slider under the fire preview)
• Lyrics settings simple again like in 1.0: where, how, 9 best styles, the rest under Advanced
• Single word mode: every word pops in smoothly at its own spot
• Floating lyrics always stay right in front of you, wherever you look
• New song: title and artist are written where the lyrics are, framed by two lines (no pop-up card)
valence.info.changelog.150:
v1.5.0
• Sky renderer from the version that worked everywhere: skies show on every PC, laptop and graphics card again
• New sky: Pink Sunset
• Quick fade when switching skies
• Lyrics: 15 one-click styles, three modes (Line, Word by word, Single word) with smooth animations
• No totem pop animation when a custom totem style is selected
• Fire height slider right under the fire preview
• New animated "Now playing" card when a song starts
valence.info.changelog.140:
v1.4.0
• The Valence skies are back (shader skies, work on every graphics card), Blood moon removed, Saturn as the only planet
• New bright skies: Sunset, Golden sunset, Blue sun and White sun
• Star signs and shooting stars for every starry sky
• Sky works in third person (F5) too
• Sky preview: look around by holding the left mouse button
• Lyrics: in the sky, floating or on screen, word by word or whole line, one-click styles, simpler settings
• Compact top bar: FPS left, ping right
• Hotbar styles under Styles (Minecraft, Glass, Minimal, Dark tiles, Neon)
• Low fire overlay
• The menu shows the last song and its cover right away
• Cosmetics removed for now, English only
